checks.detail: Bounded canonical regular-file descriptor reads reject links, changed identities, duplicate JSON members and nonfinite numbers.
Provider-specific completeness is reused, arithmetic checked, and missing or incoherent counters remain unknown.
Final total equals input plus cached-input plus cache-write-input plus output; reported total is retained once.
Final cumulative total equals input plus output; cached input is not added again.
Any incomplete retained invocation or unreceipted-provider marker prevents complete aggregate token totals.
Input population must exactly equal the hash-bound lock. Pending, failed and trial-less registered attempts remain visible and prevent complete aggregate usage.
Reported zero-generation prepare failures are separately retained; absent executed-trial usage is not fabricated as zero tokens.
Exact configuration audit permits only source_view_profile and jobs_dir differences, with common archive, route, task, resource and frozen host source bindings.
Generic comparator output is retained with its source_view_profile omission explicitly disclosed; it is supplemented by exact complete configuration comparison.
Observed attempts bind frozen start identities, exact task and provider route, retained receipt hash and postlaunch unchanged controls; unmatched or pending runtime suppresses token deltas.
Nonempty observed owner sessions must join exact invocation, session, descriptor, selected profile and mapped-span@2 metadata.

Complete closed aggregate and per-session base counter sets are required; base and edit aggregates and status totals are recomputed. Global unique counts are bounded rather than incorrectly summed across sessions.
Delivered prepare/confirmation counts identify observed helper use. Missing helper telemetry and ordinary shell/edit tool census remain unknown; helper use conveys no proof or acceptance authority.
Only fixed-key numerical metadata, bounded status tags, hashes and artifact bindings are emitted; source text, prompts, queries and transcript bodies are not exported.

Registered two-attempt full/full identity-versus-comments pair is distinct from a native Codex baseline. No billing completeness, randomization, statistical result, causality or token advantage is asserted.

limitations: This review validates the observer, not final live results; both retained preflight arms had no trial receipts and token totals remained null.
Prelaunch authenticity and custody belong to the independently frozen execution lock, not the postprocessing reader.
Retained native usage covers registered observed sessions, not unknown auxiliary providers or an independently reconciled bill.
Source counters are retained owner metadata; ordinary native tools, original-versus-compact slice composition and full bidirectional request bytes are not inferred.
Historical preflight-02 was produced before final source-count hardening and is retained as a pending-state example, not final-code live qualification.
No provider calls, source execution, production edits, full test-suite reruns, transcripts or hidden verifier contents were needed for this independent review.

owner_authored_validation.scope: Authored accounting/refusal checks plus retained content-free Docker metadata replay; not a live comparison.

resolved_findings.resolution: Collector now requires nonempty owner sessions joined to actual dispatches and exact aggregate/per-session counter key sets before reporting observed zero helper use. Four new authored refusal checks cover missing aggregate/session counters, empty sessions and missing dispatcher.

review_scope: Read-only inspection of artifact-only collector and authored validation receipts; no live outcome or raw model transcript review.
